checks.fail_message: No document title — document cannot be properly identified, catalogued, or referenced
No reference number — document cannot be tracked in any management system
No version control — cannot confirm this is the current, latest, or superseded version
No date — currency and validity of the document cannot be verified
Document type not classified (report, contract, specification, policy, letter, proposal, etc.)

checks.pass_message: Document status stated (draft, review, approved, final)
checks.fail_message: No status indicator — cannot determine if this is draft, under review, or formally approved for use
Language not identified — may cause issues for multilingual teams

checks.pass_message: Author or preparer identified with name and role
checks.fail_message: No author — accountability for document content is not established
No reviewer — document has not been independently checked or quality-assured
NO APPROVER IDENTIFIED — document may not be formally authorized. Unsigned documents have been rejected, delayed, and legally challenged in past projects.
Issuing organization not identified — institutional accountability unclear
No recipient specified — distribution and intended audience unclear
No executive summary — senior decision-makers require a concise overview before reviewing detail
NO SCOPE OR PURPOSE — document intent is unclear. Without a defined scope, the document cannot be assessed for completeness or relevance.

checks.pass_message: Key findings, conclusions, or outcomes documented
checks.fail_message: No key findings or conclusions — the document does not clearly state what was determined or decided

checks.pass_message: Action items, recommendations, or next steps identified
checks.fail_message: No action items — no clear follow-up, recommendations, or next steps defined

checks.pass_message: Key dates identified (deadlines, milestones, effective dates)
checks.fail_message: No key dates extracted — deadlines and milestones may be missed

checks.pass_message: Standards, regulations, or codes of practice referenced
checks.fail_message: No standards or regulations referenced — compliance basis not established
No compliance requirements stated — legal and regulatory obligations may not be addressed
No risks identified — risk assessment may be missing or incomplete
No confidentiality marking — document classification not stated
No copyright notice — intellectual property rights not asserted

checks.pass_message: Approval statement or sign-off found in document
checks.fail_message: No approval statement found — document may be in draft or unapproved state

checks.pass_message: Signature block or electronic signature present
checks.fail_message: No signature block — formal sign-off mechanism not present

checks.pass_message: Effective date or validity period stated
checks.fail_message: No effective date — unclear when the document takes effect or expires
